svc.backups.empty: No backups yet. One is made automatically at each launch.

svc.ha.desc: Run lights, scripts and scenes, and show sensors or the weather on your keys.
svc.ha.help: In Home Assistant, open your profile, then Security, then create a long-lived access token. Paste it here with your Home Assistant address.
svc.intro: Connect the apps your keys control. Everything saves as you type.
svc.language.desc: The language of this interface and of the default key labels. Applies immediately.
svc.logging.desc: How much detail is written to the log file. Useful when reporting a problem. Applies without a restart.
svc.logging.title: Logging
svc.maint.reset_desc: Put the pages and keys back to the defaults and delete the backups. Your connections are kept.
svc.maint.reset_prompt: Reset all pages and keys, and delete the backups?
svc.maint.title: Maintenance
svc.maint.wipe_desc: Delete the saved backup copies. Your current configuration is kept.
svc.obs.desc: Switch scenes, mute sources and change volume from your keys.
svc.obs.help: In OBS, open Tools, then WebSocket Server Settings, and enable the server. "Show Connect Info" gives you the password.
svc.obs.password_ph: Leave empty if there is no password
svc.obs.port_invalid: The port must be a number from 1 to 65535
svc.spotify.desc: Play, pause and skip tracks. Needs Spotify Premium and an open Spotify app on any device.
svc.spotify.line.no_app: This build has no built-in Spotify app: enter your own Client ID below.
svc.spotify.own_help: If connecting fails with "user not registered", create your own free Spotify app: open the developer dashboard, create an app, tick "Web API", add the redirect address shown below, then paste its Client ID here.
svc.spotify.redirect: Redirect address (must match the dashboard exactly)
svc.twitch.client_id: Own app: Client ID (empty = built-in app)
svc.twitch.desc: Make clips, run ads, change chat modes and show whether you are live. Works with several accounts.
svc.twitch.help: Click Connect and approve on twitch.tv; there is nothing to copy. Each Twitch action runs once for every account listed here.
svc.twitch.label: Name (to tell two accounts apart)
svc.twitch.own_app_help: Want your own Twitch app? Create one at dev.twitch.tv/console with client type Public and redirect URL http://localhost, then paste its Client ID here.
